column5: A walking tank covered in thick armor plates and knobbed osteoderms, ending in a heavy, bone-breaking tail club.
A giant long-necked sauropod with longer front legs than hind legs, allowing it to reach high canopy foliage.
A massive, long-necked sauropod with a heavy whip-like tail, sturdy pillar-like legs, and broad feet.
A fast, slender bipedal predator distinctive for the pair of longitudinal crests running along the top of its skull.
A duck-billed hadrosaur known for its long curved crest, used to emit low-frequency acoustic sounds.
A famous flying reptile (pterosaur, closely related to dinosaurs) with a large backward-pointing head crest and toothless beak.
Famous for its dual row of large kite-shaped plates along its back and four sharp spikes (thagomizer) on its tail.
Recognizable by its large bony frill and three sharp facial horns used for defense.
One of the largest land predators known, equipped with massive jaws and sharp serrated teeth.
A agile, feathered bipedal predator featuring a enlarged sickle-shaped claw on each hind foot.
